description: Retrieves temporary (14-day expiry) download URLs for all image fills in a Figma file; requires `imageRef` from `Paint` objects to map URLs.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for the `GetImageFills` action, specifying the Figma file.

file_key.description: The unique identifier of a Figma file. Extract this from Figma URLs: https://www.figma.com/file/{file_key}/... or https://www.figma.com/design/{file_key}/... The file_key is a 22-character alphanumeric string (e.g., 'sFHgQh9dL6369o5wrZHmdR').
file_key.title: File Key

inputSchema.title: GetImageFillsRequest

name: get_image_fills

GetImageFillsResponse.description: Response schema for the `GetImageFills` action, containing image URLs and metadata.

data.description: Contains the mapping of image references to their download URLs, along with response status information. May be empty or null in error cases.
data.title: Data

error.description: Error information if the request failed. Typically `null` for successful requests.
error.title: Error

successfull.description: Indicates if the request was successful. Typically `true` for successful requests.
successfull.title: Successfull

GetImageFillsResponse.title: GetImageFillsResponse

ImageFillsMapping.description:
A mapping from image reference IDs to their corresponding downloadable image URLs.

Keys are 40-character hexadecimal image reference IDs (found in `imageRef` attributes
within Paint objects from the 'GET /v1/files/:key' endpoint).

Values are temporary S3 URLs for downloading the images. These URLs expire after 14 days.
ImageFillsMapping.title: ImageFillsMapping

Meta.description: Metadata containing image fill URL mappings.

images.description: A mapping from image reference IDs to their corresponding downloadable image URLs. Image reference IDs are 40-character hexadecimal strings found in `imageRef` attributes within Paint objects (from 'GET /v1/files/:key'). URLs expire after 14 days.
images.title: Images

Meta.title: Meta

Model.description: Represents the core data of the response, including image URLs and status information.

error.description: Indicates if an error occurred during the request. For successful requests, this value is `false`.
error.title: Error

i18n.description: Internationalization data (reserved for future use, typically null).
i18n.title: I18N

meta.description: Metadata containing image fill URL mappings. May be absent if no image fills exist in the file.
meta.title: Meta
